shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at −2 on the number line on the left with the mark at (2,8) on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed set includes −2 at its upper bound. Right image: The displayed function has no value at x=2.
Rationales: On the left, the filled endpoint marks an inclusive boundary of the marked ray. On the right, the hollow marker omits the indicated point and there is no other plotted value at x=2.
